fusions.name: Mouldering Cut
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Puffball Slash
fusions.desc: Slashes around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 20% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut Out the Rot
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Slow Colony
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on the target, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
